title: 文件操作与退出
question: 方案保存/切换和退出如何经过执行资源边界？

current.condition: picker accepted if SaveAs/new file; cancelled picker false
current.behavior: 文件菜单绑定Save，Save选择路径后调用doc.Save并更新最近目录/方案。

current.condition: path/rebase/resource preparation; commit only after write returns
current.behavior: 调用插件PrepareSave、重基路径再写SolutionStore，写成功后才提交document/BaseDirectory/FilePath/dirty/revision。

current.condition: continuous flag disabled; activeRun not null rejects replacement
current.behavior: 先禁连续、选文件并记目录；当前运行未结束则提示返回，不直接替换文档；保存询问放行后才Load。

current.condition: nonempty owned debug/group session sets cancel and schedules second Close
current.behavior: 退出菜单调用Close；工具host异步closing先取消本次关窗，依次StopAndClose/Dispose并再排Close。

refs.excerpt: AddFileCommand(fileMenu, "退出", Close);

refs.member: protected override async void OnClosing(CancelEventArgs e)

current.to: cancel closingRun → wait activeRun changes → Close
current.behavior: 阻止首次关闭、禁窗口内容、Cancel并等待本轮owner不再activeRun，然后Dispatcher再次Close；两个closing handler的实际事件顺序不由此数组排序推定。

current.to: owner invalidation / queue Close / scope/doc release
current.behavior: 关闭后失效owner、解绑scope、释放doc，关闭callback队列并清工具配置/scope/手势；队列Close只置alive=false，不Join/drain，不能称所有后台发布已排空。

refs.excerpt:
public void Close(){lock(gate)alive=false;}
 public void Dispose()=>Close();
